title: Mismatches in a fictional parallel run
method: Synthetic comparison: 10,000 claims, 9,940 agreeing and 60 differing (99.4% agreement). Mismatch causes sum to 40+15+5=60. Agreement is not a readiness threshold; severity and comparison rules govern acceptance.
alt: Mismatches in a fictional parallel run. Rounding rule: 40 claims; Date interpretation: 15 claims; Reference data: 5 claims. Illustrative inputs.
